record.question: The _____________ woman lives in a wretched hut. Provide suitable adjective.
record.explanation: Answer D: all of these. All three adjectives (old, blind, poor) can sensibly describe the woman; the option “all of these” covers them. Independent check: All listed descriptions can grammatically modify the woman; “all of these” includes them. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/verbs-followed-by-prepositions-and-prepositions-followed-by-ing-forms; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
